items.text: The system shall continuously monitor the health and validity of all primary sensors (camera, radar, ultrasonic) and, upon detection of a sensor fault or degraded performance, immediately disengage Autopilot and alert the driver with an audible and visual warning.

The system shall detect loss or ambiguity of lane markings (e.g., faded, missing, or obscured) and, if lane confidence falls below a defined threshold, safely transition to driver‑only control while providing a clear warning.

The system shall maintain a minimum safe following distance that adapts to vehicle speed, road conditions, and traffic dynamics, and shall automatically apply emergency braking if the distance drops below the safety threshold.

The system shall require continuous driver engagement verification that combines steering‑torque detection with an in‑cab driver‑monitoring camera to ensure the driver’s eyes are on the road, and shall issue escalating alerts and disengage if engagement is lost.
The system shall limit the maximum autonomous speed based on road context (e.g., lane type, curvature, weather, visibility) and must not exceed the posted speed limit plus a defined safety margin.

The system shall provide an unambiguous, fail‑safe handover procedure that includes a timed audible tone, visual indicator, and haptic feedback to the steering wheel, giving the driver at least 2 seconds to resume full control before Autopilot disengages.

The system shall detect and classify stationary or slow‑moving road hazards (e.g., construction zones, barriers, crash attenuators) using sensor fusion, and shall either avoid them or initiate a controlled stop with driver notification.
The system shall log all Autopilot activation, disengagement, sensor status changes, and driver‑alert events with timestamps to non‑volatile storage for post‑incident analysis.
The system shall undergo periodic self‑diagnosis of software integrity and cryptographic verification of over‑the‑air updates, refusing to apply any update that fails integrity checks.

The system shall support redundancy in critical control pathways (e.g., dual CAN buses for brake and steering commands) so that a single‑point failure does not prevent safe vehicle stop or driver takeover.

things the system should do or guarantee for safe operation that the description does not cover.
Give at most 10, ranked from most to least important.

Reply with JSON only, in this shape:

System description:
# Case: Tesla Model X with Autopilot (Mountain View, California, 2018)

Source: NTSB Highway Accident Report HAR-20/01. This is a description of the system and its use before the crash. It does not include the investigation findings.

## System
A 2017 Tesla Model X has Autopilot, a SAE Level 2 partial driving automation feature. It combines Traffic-Aware Cruise Control (TACC) and Autosteer (lane keeping). The driver stays responsible for driving and monitoring the road.

## Main parts
- Sensors: a forward-facing camera, a forward-facing radar and ultrasonic sensors.
- Vision processing: a camera-based system detects lane markings, vehicles and some objects ahead.
- TACC: holds a speed set by the driver, follows a vehicle ahead at a chosen gap, and returns to the set speed when no vehicle is ahead.
- Autosteer: keeps the vehicle in its lane using lane markings and the path of the vehicle ahead.
- Forward collision warning and automatic emergency braking are available as separate features.
- Driver monitoring: steering torque is used to check that the driver's hands are on the wheel, with visual and audible alerts if no hands are detected for a period of time.

## People
- The driver sets the cruising speed, turns Autopilot on, and is told to keep hands on the wheel and watch the road.
- Other road users and road workers share the highway. Road agencies maintain road markings and safety hardware such as barriers and crash attenuators.

## Operating context
Busy multi-lane freeway with high-occupancy-vehicle (HOV) lanes, exits and interchanges, lane markings of different quality, and traffic that changes in speed.
